arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
sudo -n -H /opt/telegram-robot-leads/.venv/bin/python -B - <<'PY'
import asyncio,json,stat,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,"/opt/telegram-robot-leads/scripts")
from telethon_sessions import DEFAULT_VAULT,inspect
from organic_growth import read_model,ensure_voluntary_request_link,VOLUNTARY_LINK_FILE
from safe_runtime import _connected_client
p=Path("/opt/telegram-robot-leads/.verified-source-commit")
expected="06651386feaccbd528378aae4fc1469751afa57d"
assert p.read_text().strip()==expected
config=inspect(DEFAULT_VAULT)
model=read_model(DEFAULT_VAULT,config["group"])
assert model is not None and model["approve_join_requests"] is True and model["publish_in_owned_channel"] is False
outcome=asyncio.run(ensure_voluntary_request_link(config,model,DEFAULT_VAULT,_connected_client))
assert outcome["status"] in {"CREATED","REUSED","EXISTING_VERIFIED"}
assert outcome["request_needed"] is True and outcome["link_recorded"] is True
assert outcome["members_added"]==0
path=DEFAULT_VAULT/VOLUNTARY_LINK_FILE
metadata=path.stat()
assert stat.S_ISREG(metadata.st_mode) and stat.S_IMODE(metadata.st_mode)==0o600
print("OFFICIAL_JOIN_LINK",json.dumps(outcome,sort_keys=True),flush=True)
print("PRIVATE_LINK_STORED_WITH_OWNER_ONLY_ACCESS",True,flush=True)
print("NO_MEMBERS_CONTACTED",True,flush=True)
print("NO_UNSOLICITED_MESSAGES",True,flush=True)
print("VOLUNTARY_JOIN_LINK_VERIFIED",flush=True)
PY
